### Create new provider config
POST /payments/custom-provider/connect
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/payments/custom-provider/connect
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/payments/create-config | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/payments/create-config.md

API to create a new payment config for given location

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: payments/custom-provider.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "Lk3nlfk4lxlelVEwcW") - Location id

Request body (required) (application/json) ConnectCustomProvidersConfigDto:
- live* object - Live config containing api-key and publishable key for live payments
  - apiKey* string (e.g. "y5ZQxryRFXZHvUJZdLeXXXXX") - Api-key for custom payment provider config
  - publishableKey* string (e.g. "rzp_test_zPRoVMLOa0XXXX") - Publishable-key for custom payment provider config
- test* object - Test config containing api-key and publishable-key for test payments
  - apiKey* string (e.g. "y5ZQxryRFXZHvUJZdLeXXXXX") - Api-key for custom payment provider config
  - publishableKey* string (e.g. "rzp_test_zPRoVMLOa0XXXX") - Publishable-key for custom payment provider config

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- name* string - The name of the custom provider
- description* string - Description of payment gateway. Shown on the payments integrations page as subtext
- paymentsUrl* string - This url will be loaded in iFrame to start a payment session.
- queryUrl* string - The url used for querying payments related events. Ex. verify, refund, subscription etc.
- imageUrl* string - Public image url for logo of the payment gateway displayed on the payments integrations page.
- _id* string - The unique identifier for the custom provider.
- locationId* string - Location id
- marketplaceAppId* string - The application id of marketplace
- paymentProvider object - Payment provider details.
- deleted* boolean - Whether the config is deleted or not. true represents config is deleted
- createdAt* string (format: date-time) - The creation timestamp of the custom provider.
- updatedAt* string (format: date-time) - The last update timestamp of the custom provider.
- traceId string - Trace id of the custom provider.

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (No such config exists for given locationId and marketplaceAppId) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string

### Create Coupon
POST /payments/coupon
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/payments/coupon
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/payments/create-coupon | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/payments/create-coupon.md

The "Create Coupon" API allows you to create a new promotional coupon with customizable parameters such as discount amount, validity period, usage limits, and applicable products. Use this endpoint to set up promotional offers and special discounts for your customers.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: payments/coupons.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCouponParams:
- altId* string (e.g. "BQdAwxa0ky1iK2sstLGJ") - Location Id
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- name* string (e.g. "New Year Sale") - Coupon Name
- code* string (e.g. "LEVELUPDAY2022") - Coupon Code
- discountType* string (enum: percentage | amount; e.g. "amount") - Discount Type
- discountValue* number (e.g. 10) - Discount Value
- startDate* string (e.g. "2023-01-01T22:45:00.000Z") - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- endDate string (e.g. "2023-01-31T22:45:00.000Z") - End date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- usageLimit number (e.g. 10) - Max number of times coupon can be used
- productIds string[] (e.g. ["6241712be68f7a98102ba272"]) - Product Ids
- priceIds string[] (e.g. ["6241712be68f7a98102ba272"]) - Price Ids
- variantIds string[] (e.g. ["6241712be68f7a98102ba272"]) - Variant Ids
- applyToFuturePayments boolean (default: true) - Is Coupon applicable on upcoming subscription transactions
- applyToFuturePaymentsConfig object (default: {"type":"forever"}) - If coupon is applicable on upcoming subscription transactions, how many months should it be applicable for a subscription
  - type* string (enum: forever | fixed; e.g. "forever | fixed") - Type of the config
  - duration* number (e.g. 5) - Duration the coupon to be applied in a subscription
  - durationType* string (enum: months; e.g. "months") - Type of the duration
- limitPerCustomer boolean (default: false) - Limits whether a coupon can be redeemed only once per customer.

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - Unique MongoDB identifier for the coupon
- usageCount* number - Number of times the coupon has been used
- limitPerCustomer* number - Maximum number of times a customer can use this coupon (0 for unlimited)
- altId* string - Location Id
- altType* string - Type of entity
- name* string - Display name of the coupon
- code* string - Redemption code for the coupon
- discountType* string (enum: percentage | amount) - Type of discount (percentage or amount)
- discountValue* number - Value of the discount (percentage or fixed amount)
- status* string (enum: scheduled | active | expired) - Current status of the coupon
- startDate* string - Date when the coupon becomes active
- endDate string - End date when the coupon expires
- applyToFuturePayments* boolean - Indicates if the coupon applies to future recurring payments
- applyToFuturePaymentsConfig* object - Configuration for how the coupon applies to future payments
  - type* string (enum: forever | fixed) - Type of future payments configuration
  - duration number - Duration value for fixed type configurations
  - durationType string - Duration type for fixed configurations (e.g. months)
- userId string - User ID associated with the coupon (if applicable)
- createdAt* string - Creation timestamp
- updatedAt* string - Last update timestamp
- traceId* string - Unique identifier for tracing this API request

Errors: 422 (422: see Common error responses)

### Create White-label Integration Provider
POST /payments/integrations/provider/whitelabel
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/payments/integrations/provider/whitelabel
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/payments/create-integration-provider | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/payments/create-integration-provider.md

The "Create White-label Integration Provider" API allows adding a new payment provider integration to the system which is built on top of Authorize.net or NMI. Use this endpoint to create a integration provider with the specified details. Ensure that the required information is provided in the request payload. This endpoint can be only invoked using marketplace-app token

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: payments/integration.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateWhiteLabelIntegrationProviderDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - location Id / company Id based on altType
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- uniqueName* string (e.g. "easy-direct") - A unique name given to the integration provider, uniqueName must start and end with a character. Only lowercase characters and hyphens (-) are supported
- title* string (e.g. "Title") - The title or name of the integration provider.
- provider* string (enum: authorize-net | nmi) - The type of payment provider associated with the integration provider.
- description* string (e.g. "Description") - A brief description providing additional information about the integration provider.
- imageUrl* string (e.g. "https://example.com/image.jpg") - The URL to an image representing the integration provider. The imageUrl should start with "https://" and ensure that this URL is publicly accessible.

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - The unique identifier of the integration provider.
- altId* string - The altId / locationId of the integration provider.
- altType* string - The altType of the integration provider.
- title* string - The title or name of the integration provider.
- route* string - The route name associated with the integration provider.
- provider* string - The payment provider associated with the integration provider.
- description* string - A brief description providing additional information about the integration provider.
- imageUrl* string - The URL to an image representing the integration provider.
- createdAt* string (format: date-time) - The timestamp when the integration provider was created.
- updatedAt* string (format: date-time) - The timestamp when the integration provider was last updated.

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

- altId* string (e.g. "3SwdhCu3svxI8AKsPJt6") - AltId is the unique identifier e.g: location id.
- altType* string (e.g. "location") - AltType is the type of identifier.
- paymentMode string (e.g. "live") - Mode of payment.
- startAt string (e.g. "2024-02-01") - Starting interval of transactions.
- endAt string (e.g. "2024-02-13") - Closing interval of transactions.
- entitySourceType string (e.g. "funnel") - Source of the transactions.
- entitySourceSubType string (e.g. "two_step_order_form") - Source sub-type of the transactions.
- search string (e.g. "Awesome transaction") - The name of the transaction for searching.
- subscriptionId string (e.g. "sub_1KGcXDCScnf89tZoVkoEMCEL") - Subscription id for filtering of transactions.
- entityId string (e.g. "61dd0fe9c077f73e67f78803") - Entity id for filtering of transactions.
- contactId string (e.g. "XPLSw2SVagl12LMDeTmQ") - Contact id for filtering of transactions.
- limit number (default: 10; e.g. 20) - The maximum number of items to be included in a single page of results
- offset number (default: 0) - The starting index of the page, indicating the position from which the results should be retrieved.

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- data* object[] - An array of transactions
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the transaction.
  - altId* string - AltId is the unique identifier eg: location id.
  - altType* string - AltType is the type of identifier.
  - contactId string - Contact id corresponding to the transaction.
  - mergedFromContactId string - ID of the contact that was merged from.
  - contactName string - Contact name corresponding to the transaction.
  - contactEmail string - Contact email corresponding to the transaction.
  - currency string - Currency in which transaction occurred.
  - amount number - Transaction value.
  - status* object - The status of the transaction (e.g., succeeded).
  - liveMode boolean - Transaction is in live / test mode.
  - entityType string - Entity type of transaction (eg: order).
  - entityId string - Entity id for the transaction. e.g: order id
  - entitySourceType* string - Entity source type of transaction (eg: funnel).
  - entitySourceSubType string - Entity source sub-type of the transactions.
  - entitySourceName string - Entity source name for the transaction.
  - entitySourceId string - Entity source id for the transaction.
  - entitySourceMeta object - Meta content for the entity source of transaction.
  - subscriptionId string - Subscription id for transaction.
  - chargeId string - Charge id for transaction.
  - chargeSnapshot object - Charge snapshot of transaction.
  - paymentProviderType string - Payment provider for transaction.
  - paymentProviderConnectedAccount string - Payment provider account id for transaction.
  - ipAddress string - Ip address from where transaction was initiated.
  - createdAt* string (format: date-time) - The creation timestamp of the transaction.
  - updatedAt* string (format: date-time) - The update timestamp of the transaction.
  - amountRefunded number - Transaction amount refunded.
  - paymentMethod object - Transaction payment method details.
  - fulfilledAt* string (format: date-time) - The charged timestamp of the transaction.
  - createdBy string - User ID who created the transaction.
- totalCount* number - total transactions count

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Record Order Payment
POST /payments/orders/{orderId}/record-payment
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/payments/orders/{orderId}/record-payment
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/payments/record-order-payment | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/payments/record-order-payment.md

The "Record Order Payment" API allows to record a payment for an order. Use this endpoint to record payment for an order and update the order status to "Paid".

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: payments/orders.collectPayment

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- orderId* string (e.g. "5e2d4c8e0e8b4e001c1c4f5d") - Order ID

Request body (required) (application/json) PostRecordOrderPaymentBody:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - location Id / company Id based on altType
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- mode* string (enum: cash | card | cheque | bank_transfer | other; e.g. "card") - manual payment method
- card object - Details of Card if used for payment
  - type* string (enum: visa | mastercard | other; e.g. "mastercard")
  - last4* string (e.g. "1234") - Last 4 digit of the card
- cheque object - Details of the Cheque if used for payment
  - number* string (e.g. "129-129-129-912") - check number
- notes string (e.g. "This was a direct payment") - Any note to be recorded with the transaction
- amount number (e.g. 100) - Amount to be paid against the invoice.
- meta object - Meta data to be recorded with the transaction
- isPartialPayment boolean - Indicates if the order is intended to be a partial payment.

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success status of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Order not found) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string

### Update Coupon
PUT /payments/coupon
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/payments/coupon
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/payments/update-coupon | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/payments/update-coupon.md

The "Update Coupon" API enables you to modify existing coupon details such as discount values, validity periods, usage limits, and other promotional parameters. Use this endpoint to adjust or extend promotional offers for your customers.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: payments/coupons.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateCouponParams:
- altId* string (e.g. "BQdAwxa0ky1iK2sstLGJ") - Location Id
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- name* string (e.g. "New Year Sale") - Coupon Name
- code* string (e.g. "LEVELUPDAY2022") - Coupon Code
- discountType* string (enum: percentage | amount; e.g. "amount") - Discount Type
- discountValue* number (e.g. 10) - Discount Value
- startDate* string (e.g. "2023-01-01T22:45:00.000Z") - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- endDate string (e.g. "2023-01-31T22:45:00.000Z") - End date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- usageLimit number (e.g. 10) - Max number of times coupon can be used
- productIds string[] (e.g. ["6241712be68f7a98102ba272"]) - Product Ids
- priceIds string[] (e.g. ["6241712be68f7a98102ba272"]) - Price Ids
- variantIds string[] (e.g. ["6241712be68f7a98102ba272"]) - Variant Ids
- applyToFuturePayments boolean (default: true) - Is Coupon applicable on upcoming subscription transactions
- applyToFuturePaymentsConfig object (default: {"type":"forever"}) - If coupon is applicable on upcoming subscription transactions, how many months should it be applicable for a subscription
  - type* string (enum: forever | fixed; e.g. "forever | fixed") - Type of the config
  - duration* number (e.g. 5) - Duration the coupon to be applied in a subscription
  - durationType* string (enum: months; e.g. "months") - Type of the duration
- limitPerCustomer boolean (default: false) - Limits whether a coupon can be redeemed only once per customer.
- id* string (e.g. "6241712be68f7a98102ba272") - Coupon Id

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - Unique MongoDB identifier for the coupon
- usageCount* number - Number of times the coupon has been used
- limitPerCustomer* number - Maximum number of times a customer can use this coupon (0 for unlimited)
- altId* string - Location Id
- altType* string - Type of entity
- name* string - Display name of the coupon
- code* string - Redemption code for the coupon
- discountType* string (enum: percentage | amount) - Type of discount (percentage or amount)
- discountValue* number - Value of the discount (percentage or fixed amount)
- status* string (enum: scheduled | active | expired) - Current status of the coupon
- startDate* string - Date when the coupon becomes active
- endDate string - End date when the coupon expires
- applyToFuturePayments* boolean - Indicates if the coupon applies to future recurring payments
- applyToFuturePaymentsConfig* object - Configuration for how the coupon applies to future payments
  - type* string (enum: forever | fixed) - Type of future payments configuration
  - duration number - Duration value for fixed type configurations
  - durationType string - Duration type for fixed configurations (e.g. months)
- userId string - User ID associated with the coupon (if applicable)
- createdAt* string - Creation timestamp
- updatedAt* string - Last update timestamp
- traceId* string - Unique identifier for tracing this API request

Errors: 422 (422: see Common error responses)
